## Specific task description

Task instruction: Push the red stapler with silver chamber down with one arm the left arm.

Task description: The object is the red stapler with a silver staple cartridge at the front left of the table. Press it downward using only the left arm.

Success criteria: The left gripper must press downward on the stapler and make actual contact near the target pressing point. Contact must be close both horizontally and vertically; hovering above does not count.

## Execution tips

- Prefer contacting a wide surface on the red top cover that can support the pads. Avoid its narrow edge and the side of the silver staple magazine to reduce slipping or pushing sideways.
- When there is clearance above the stapler, slightly close the left gripper so its fingertips land on the top cover. Avoid an overly wide opening that lets the fingers pass on either side without pressing the cover.
- After approaching the lid, press down in small steps perpendicular to the tabletop and use live contact feedback to adjust. Avoid pressing diagonally or continuing a large downward movement after contact.
